items.title: Uber’s Legal AI Agent Cuts Contract Review Time by 20% with Rules and RAG
items.summary: Uber’s Legal Redlining Agent reviews contract changes in Microsoft Word using RAG, historical lawyer feedback, and deterministic policy rules. Built with LangGraph, OpenSearch, and Redis, the system r...
items.description: Uber’s Legal Redlining Agent reviews contract changes in Microsoft Word using RAG, historical lawyer feedback, and deterministic policy rules. Built with LangGraph, OpenSearch, and Redis, the system reports more than 20% lower average contract review time and 91% accuracy in AI-generated decisions. Uber is exploring agentic harnesses, skills, legal ontologies, and knowledge graphs. By Leela Kumili

Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data
items.summary: Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search. The approach uses de-identified booking sessions and large language models...
items.description: Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search. The approach uses de-identified booking sessions and large language models (LLMs) to jointly generate synthetic search queries and relevance labels, enabling model training before sufficient real search traffic is available. By Robert Krzaczyński

items.title: Article: Governed Autonomous Intelligence for Mission-Critical Utility
items.summary: The article describes an architecture for agentic AI in regulated utility operations. Agents reason and propose actions, but a deterministic policy gate and a governed tool gateway control execution, ...
items.description: The article describes an architecture for agentic AI in regulated utility operations. Agents reason and propose actions, but a deterministic policy gate and a governed tool gateway control execution, with human approval where required. items.title: GitHub Rebuilds the Copilot App's Diff Surface to Open Million-Line Pull Requests Without Jank
items.summary: GitHub engineers rebuilt the diff view in the Copilot app to handle a pull request with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines and 400 inline comments. The design separates fixed-height code rows f...
items.description: GitHub engineers rebuilt the diff view in the Copilot app to handle a pull request with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines and 400 inline comments. The design separates fixed-height code rows from variable-height comment blocks, which are measured in batches near the viewport. Performance is checked through CI budgets and automated app runs. By Daniel Curtis

items.description: AWS has launched Nitro Sandboxes, running each opted-in EKS pod, ECS task or EC2 workload in its own Firecracker microVM with a separate kernel, enabled by one runtimeClassName field at no extra charge. items.description: A recently disclosed vulnerability in OpenSSH lets an unauthenticated attacker log into accounts that should have no usable password. items.title: Cohere Finding Shows Self-Hosted Open-Weight Models Still Need Egress Controls
items.summary: Cohere recently reported that one of Alibaba’s newest Qwen3.8 models attempted to upload a probe file to a storage container in Beijing while explicitly stating in its reasoning trace that no tools wo...
items.description: Cohere recently reported that one of Alibaba’s newest Qwen3.8 models attempted to upload a probe file to a storage container in Beijing while explicitly stating in its reasoning trace that no tools would be triggered. While there is no evidence of intentional backdooring, the report is a reminder that, even for self-hosted agents based on open-weight models, egress risks exist and need mitigation.

items.title: Node.js Brings Debounce, Throttle, and PKCS#12 Parsing Into Core Modules
items.summary: Node.js 26.10.0 adds util.debounce() and util.throttle(), plus util.markPromiseAsHandled(), to the core library. It also introduces crypto.parsePKCS12() for reading .p12 and .pfx bundles, and extends ...
items.description: Node.js 26.10.0 adds util.debounce() and util.throttle(), plus util.markPromiseAsHandled(), to the core library. It also introduces crypto.parsePKCS12() for reading .p12 and .pfx bundles, and extends the experimental Virtual File System to node:ffi. The additions reduce the need for some userland dependencies. Node.js 26 is now Active LTS. By Daniel Curtis

items.summary: Google Cloud has made date-based versioning of the Compute Engine API generally available, replacing the single mutable /v1 surface with immutable quarterly snapshots such as 2026-09-01, selected per ...
items.description: Google Cloud has made date-based versioning of the Compute Engine API generally available, replacing the single mutable /v1 surface with immutable quarterly snapshots such as 2026-09-01, selected per request with a header or query parameter. New versions can change defaults, error formats, and IAM checks without touching /v1 callers, a model Azure Resource Manager and Stripe have used for years.
